extension.description: Close tabs you are not using and color tab labels by file type
configuration.title: Auto Close Classified Tabs
configuration.maxTabs.description: How many tabs to keep in each editor group. Unsaved and pinned tabs are never closed, so the actual count can go above this.
configuration.maxTabsByType.description: Per-type tab limits, applied before `maxTabs`. Keys are the color names listed in the README (`diff`, `docs`, `json`, `typescript`, …); a type not listed here is only bound by `maxTabs`. Example: `{ "diff": 1, "docs": 2 }`
configuration.closeOnStartup.description: Close tabs right after a window opens. Turn this off to keep a restored session as it is — tabs are still closed as soon as you open the next one, so this only buys you the chance to pin what you want to keep.
configuration.closePreviewFirst.descript: Close preview tabs (shown in italics) before ordinary tabs.
configuration.colors.enabled.description: Color tab labels and show a badge based on the file type.
configuration.colors.rules.description: Override which type a file gets. A key containing `/` matches anywhere in the path, otherwise it matches the end of the path. Example: `{ ".proto": "sql", "docs/": "docs" }`
command.closeUnused.title: Close Unused Tabs Now
command.toggleProtect.title: Protect From Auto Close (Toggle Pin)
command.enableTabDecorations.title: Show Type Colors on Tabs Only
command.restoreDecorationDefaults.title: Restore Default Colors and Badges
command.applyLabelIcons.title: Add Type Icons to Tab Names
command.removeLabelIcons.title: Remove Type Icons From Tab Names
color.diff: Tabs showing diffs and Git versions of a file
color.toml: Tabs showing TOML and INI files
color.sql: Tabs showing SQL and schema files
color.shell: Tabs showing shell and small scripting languages
color.jvm: Tabs showing Java, Kotlin and Scala
color.cfamily: Tabs showing C, C++ and Zig
color.html: Tabs showing HTML, Vue and Svelte
